features: mean primary odds above the file median
primary odds above the strongest available two-sentence flank
mean isolated odds above the file median
isolated odds above the strongest available two-sentence flank
log fraction of the document-wide sentence count

protocol.advance: Three additional strict locations on distinct new works across both generator families, at most two genuine works flagged by the candidate, and at least 90% candidate coverage of changed versions. Review-only research response with zero authorship confidence weight.
protocol.comparison: Unchanged first six native primary windows at .50 and, on previously scored works only, actual published worker packets.
protocol.fit: Already consumed text-changed OpAI report variants and their originals. Train one positive-versus-negative interval ranker per arm with equal source and within-source class weights.
protocol.fit_parameters: Source and class-weighted logistic ranker, standardized features, 120 fixed gradient steps of .35, ridge .10 on each non-intercept coefficient.
protocol.interval: All same-paragraph runs of one to twelve native sentences, at least 60 non-whitespace characters, no more than 80% of the document characters, and at least one available same-paragraph flank. Choose one highest response with a deterministic position tie-break.
protocol.point: The second-highest score on the 16 separate genuine report files. Select only a higher value.
protocol.source: Fresh same-domain works are selected in a salted ID order from the first 48 eligible-by-ID shared Gemini and Nano works. Exclude all Qwen test works and all earlier roster IDs before source geometry checks.
protocol.supervision: Positive intervals have at least 30% IoU and 50% recall over all annotated non-whitespace edit characters.
